units.source_text: 古歌：“不厌人情薄，流连在世荣。

en.t: An old poem says: Untroubled by the thinness of human affection, one lingers amid worldly glory.

units.source_text: 会当蹈覆辙，意外受讥评。”

en.t: In time one is sure to follow the same disastrous path and unexpectedly incur criticism.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
